response.courseDescription: 230 Honors Introductory Linear Algebra An introduction to linear algebra with an emphasis on conceptual development. Credit not granted for more than one of MATH 230, 220, and 225.
response.coursePrerequisites: MATH 106 or 201 with a C or better, or MATH 140, 171, 202 or DATA 121 or higher or concurrent enrollment, or a minimum ALEKS math placement score of 80%.
